aggregation: Median of three per-round medians. Paired ratios divide before by after within each round; ratio of aggregated medians is reported separately.
timing_interpretation: CPU view/recording, CPU submission, GPU queries and full-frame readback are distinct intervals. GPU queries exclude upfront renderer preparation and geometry/instance uploads, but include on-demand palette texture creation/update inside draw_shaded; they are not pure shader time. Do not sum CPU and GPU or infer pipelined FPS. Retained process/GPU memory includes caches. Clocks are observed without power-setting changes; shared desktop applications remain running.
gpu_query_boundary: Excludes upfront renderer preparation and geometry/instance uploads. Includes on-demand palette texture creation/update inside draw_shaded, plus shader drawing; excludes framebuffer readback. GPU query is not pure shader execution time.
rendering_work: Identical fixture, character counts and sampled times. Palette atlas batching intentionally changes draw counts; upload bytes and draws are compared and recorded, rather than required equal. Final PNG/RGB equality remains mandatory.
cpu_comparison: Palette computation moves from generated views into renderer preparation inside CPU submission, before the GPU query. Compare both CPU intervals and full-frame readback. The sum of separate view/submission round medians is a derived estimate, not the median of combined per-frame samples.

rendering_work.note: Palette atlas batching intentionally changes draw counts. Exact final sampled-frame PNG and RGB equality are checked separately.

derived_cpu_view_plus_submit_ms.interpretation: Sum of separate view/recording and CPU-submission per-round medians. This is a derived estimate, not the median of combined per-frame samples. GPU time is not included.
